author: Karl Rock
description:
This stranger started following us through Pakka Qila in Hyderabad, Sindh, and kept asking me the same question: how can I get to New Zealand?

I wish I could've helped him, but I don't know how he could get there. New Zealand visas can be difficult to get. Even my own wife, who's an Indian national, has had a difficult time with the visa process.

I hope this guy finds the opportunity he's looking for 🙏
title: The #2 Question I Get in Pakistan
